title: LineFair AgreementTermsV1 JSON boundary — canonical encoding v1 FROZEN 2026-10-27
description: JSON edge only; never hashed directly. Parsed into the Rust struct and Borsh-encoded per docs/20 §Canonical terms encoding v1 (Rust is the reference). Property order below equals Borsh field order. Cross-field rules (distinct roles, bps sum = 10000, line_id == array index, deadline ordering, checked u64 sums, allowlisted FT) are enforced in the contract and cannot be expressed here.

agreement_nonce.description: Agreement nonce. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

acceptance_deadline_ns.description: Chain time ns. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

funding_deadline_ns.description: Chain time ns; ≥ acceptance_deadline_ns. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

delivery_grace_period_ns.description: Default "0". Bounds 0..=2592000000000000 ns. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

review_window_ns.description: Default "259200000000000" (72h). Bounds 60000000000..=2592000000000000 ns (60 s..30 days), enforced onchain. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

negotiation_window_ns.description: Default "172800000000000" (48h). Bounds 60000000000..=2592000000000000 ns (60 s..30 days), enforced onchain. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

primary_window_ns.description: Default "259200000000000" (72h). Bounds 60000000000..=2592000000000000 ns (60 s..30 days), enforced onchain. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

backup_window_ns.description: Default "259200000000000" (72h). Bounds 60000000000..=2592000000000000 ns (60 s..30 days), enforced onchain. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

lines.description: Ordered; line_id must equal array index.

principal.description: FT base units, canonical decimal u128 > 0; range-checked on parse.

delivery_deadline_ns.description: Chain time ns; ≥ funding_deadline_ns. Canonical decimal u64 string; range-checked ≤ 18446744073709551615 on parse.

acceptance_criteria_commitment.description: Exactly 32 bytes, lowercase hex; salted commitment per docs/20 (linefair/criteria/v1). Never raw text.
